prompt: Excellent. Now a NATURE KIT SHEET for the crag biome, same rendering style (stylized painterly, hand-painted, warm golden key light from the upper left, cool teal shadows, gentle muted saturation), but laid out as a game-asset reference sheet: every piece fully ISOLATED on a flat light neutral grey background, no landscape, no sky, no clouds, each piece with a soft contact shadow and a short clean hand-lettered label beneath it. Game-asset clarity: chunky readable shapes, clumped foliage masses, detail painted not modelled. Arrange in tidy rows. ROW 1, TREES: "wind-bent pine A" and "wind-bent pine B" (two different silhouettes, flat clumped needle pads, trunks bent hard to one side), "juniper A" and "juniper B" (stunted, low, twisted, one growing sideways out of a small rock chunk). ROW 2, UNDERSTORY AND GROUND COVER: "cushion plant" (tight green dome with tiny flowers), "alpine flowers" (small bright clump of blue gentians and white and pink star flowers), "lichen rock", "wind-flattened grass clump", "turf patch" (thin alpine turf mat with a ragged edge), "scree pile". ROW 3, ROCKS: four cragslate pieces in grey-blue layered sharp rock: "cragslate boulder", "split boulder", "ledge outcrop", "natural stair" (rock stepped like stairs), "spire rock"; then two wild-crag rocks: "cinder rock" and "ore-seam rock" (cinder-black with glinting gold ore seams). ROW 4, ISLE PIECES: "lip piece" (a section of isle edge: thin turf overhanging layered cragslate ledges, a pine jutting sideways) and "underside piece" (a downward-tapering chunk of stepped grey-blue cragslate with a small juniper growing sideways and a wisp of falling water spray). At the right end, a simple neutral 1.8 m human figure labelled "1.8 m" for scale, with all pieces at consistent scale to it. Title at top: "CRAG - nature kit". Wide landscape format.
